subject: [hw] DONE T02 rev 3: load-time `set` rule for V40 (6170/6170)
body:
Rev 3 adds one optional script line requested by V40:
  set WIN OFF VALUE
It is a load-time initial register value (not a register access, no power needed), recorded as "SCRIPT default WIN 0xOFF = 0xVALUE"; apply_rules ignores it. No other interface change.

Last lines:
  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/hw/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST T02-hw PASS 6170/6170
  $ bash gpu/hwcodec/tests/check/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST T02-check PASS 22/22
(ASan+UBSan, -O2, TSan; new defaults.txt check.)

Not-done list unchanged: 40-daemon-encode is a template pending hw-ip/hw-p03; run_phone_tests.sh needs $PHONE_EXEC; rwvc_probe iOS link not done; no phone run; fake POLL uses a global timeout because the frozen regs() callback has no poll_timeout field. STATUS updated. R1 accepted rev 2; staying available for hw-r2/integrators.
